//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Grindstone Sharper Tools -> Config

Enable Grindstone Sharper Tools.//: Whether Grindstone Sharper Tools is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

usesAfterGrinding.//: The amount of sharper uses a tool has after using it on the grindstone. min: 1, max: 5,000

sharpenedDamageModifier.//: The damage modifier of sharpened tools. min: 0, max: 100

infiniteCreativeUses.//: Whether to decrease sharpened uses in creative.

sendUsesLeftInChat.//: Sends the sharpened tool user a message at 75%, 50%, 25%, 10%.

showUsesLeftInItemName.//: Shows the uses left in the name of the item.

nameUsesPrefix.//: The prefix of the sharpened uses left in the tool name.

nameUsesSuffix.//: The suffix of the sharpened uses left in the tool name.
